words.exampleEnglish: We are good friends.
words.hintSimplified: 我和你，还有别的人，是同一个小组，怎么称呼这个小组？
words.hintTraditional: 我和你，還有別的人，是同一個小組，怎麼稱呼這個小組？
words.hintEnglish: Me, you, and some others are in the same group. What do we call that group?

words.exampleEnglish: Are you all free tomorrow?
words.hintSimplified: 对好几个人说话时，用哪个词称呼这些人？
words.hintTraditional: 對好幾個人說話時，用哪個詞稱呼這些人？
words.hintEnglish: When talking to several people, which word do you use to address them?

words.exampleEnglish: They are all my colleagues.
words.hintSimplified: 说到一群人，但是不包括我和你，用哪个词？
words.hintTraditional: 說到一群人，但是不包括我和你，用哪個詞？
words.hintEnglish: To talk about a group of people that includes neither me nor you, which word do you use?

words.exampleEnglish: They are chatting in the park.
words.hintSimplified: 说到一群女生或女士时，用哪个词？
words.hintTraditional: 說到一群女生或女士時，用哪個詞？
words.hintEnglish: Which word do you use when talking about a group of girls or women?

words.gloss: surname and given name; full name
words.definition: surname and given name; full name
words.exampleSimplified: 请在这里写下你的姓名。
words.exampleTraditional: 請在這裡寫下你的姓名。
words.exampleEnglish: Please write your full name here.
words.hintSimplified: 表格上要你填的，包括姓和名。
words.hintTraditional: 表格上要你填的，包括姓和名。
words.hintEnglish: Something a form asks you to fill in, including your family name and given name.

words.exampleEnglish: He has been to China twice.
words.hintSimplified: 一个亚洲大国，首都是北京。
words.hintTraditional: 一個亞洲大國，首都是北京。
words.hintEnglish: A big Asian country whose capital is Beijing.

words.exampleEnglish: My friend studies at a university in the United States.
words.hintSimplified: 一个有五十个州的国家，说英文。
words.hintTraditional: 一個有五十個州的國家，說英文。
words.hintEnglish: A country with fifty states, where English is spoken.

words.exampleEnglish: Japan's cherry blossoms are very pretty.
words.hintSimplified: 一个岛国，首都是东京。
words.hintTraditional: 一個島國，首都是東京。
words.hintEnglish: An island country in Asia whose capital is Tokyo.

words.definition: Taiwan; variant of 臺灣|台湾[Tai2 wan1]
words.exampleEnglish: Summers in Taiwan are very hot.
words.hintSimplified: 太平洋上的一座岛，珍珠奶茶就是从这里来的。
words.hintTraditional: 太平洋上的一座島，珍珠奶茶就是從這裡來的。
words.hintEnglish: An island in the Pacific; bubble tea comes from here.

words.exampleEnglish: How do you write your name?
words.hintSimplified: 别人叫你的时候，用的是什么？
words.hintTraditional: 別人叫你的時候，用的是什麼？
words.hintEnglish: What do other people use when they call you?

words.definition: CL:通[tong1]; CL:部[bu4]; phone call; phone number; telephone
words.exampleEnglish: I'll call you tonight.
words.hintSimplified: 它响的时候，你拿起来和远方的人说话。
words.hintTraditional: 它響的時候，你拿起來和遠方的人說話。
words.hintEnglish: When it rings, you pick it up and talk to someone far away.

words.definition: (concept of) time; (duration of) time; (point in) time
words.exampleEnglish: I don't have time to eat breakfast.
words.hintSimplified: 钟表告诉我们的东西，常常不够用。
words.hintTraditional: 鐘錶告訴我們的東西，常常不夠用。
words.hintEnglish: What a clock tells us; there's often not enough of it.

words.exampleEnglish: This movie is two hours long.
words.hintSimplified: 比分钟长，一天有二十四个。
words.hintTraditional: 比分鐘長，一天有二十四個。
words.hintEnglish: Longer than a minute; a day has twenty-four of them.

words.exampleEnglish: I'm at home now.
words.hintSimplified: 不是过去，也不是未来，就是这一刻。
words.hintTraditional: 不是過去，也不是未來，就是這一刻。
words.hintEnglish: Not the past and not the future, just this moment.

words.exampleEnglish: I'm twenty this year.
words.hintSimplified: 我们现在正在过的这一年。
words.hintTraditional: 我們現在正在過的這一年。
words.hintEnglish: The year we are living in right now.

words.exampleEnglish: The weather is very nice today.
words.hintSimplified: 不是昨天，也不是明天，是这一天。
words.hintTraditional: 不是昨天，也不是明天，是這一天。
words.hintEnglish: Not yesterday and not tomorrow, but this very day.

words.exampleEnglish: We're going hiking tomorrow.
words.hintSimplified: 今天睡一觉之后的那一天。
words.hintTraditional: 今天睡一覺之後的那一天。
words.hintEnglish: The day that comes after you sleep tonight.

words.exampleEnglish: I didn't have class yesterday.
words.hintSimplified: 今天的前一天。
words.hintTraditional: 今天的前一天。
words.hintEnglish: The day before today.

words.exampleEnglish: I get up at seven every morning.
words.hintSimplified: 太阳刚出来的时候。
words.hintTraditional: 太陽剛出來的時候。
words.hintEnglish: When the sun has just come up.

words.exampleEnglish: I have two classes in the morning.
words.hintSimplified: 从天亮到十二点以前的时间。
words.hintTraditional: 從天亮到十二點以前的時間。
words.hintEnglish: The time from daybreak until just before noon.

words.exampleEnglish: Let's eat lunch together at noon.
words.hintSimplified: 太阳最高、该吃午饭的时候。
words.hintTraditional: 太陽最高、該吃午飯的時候。
words.hintEnglish: When the sun is highest and it's time for lunch.

words.exampleEnglish: I'm going to the library this afternoon.
words.hintSimplified: 午饭以后到天黑以前的时间。
words.hintTraditional: 午飯以後到天黑以前的時間。
words.hintEnglish: The time after lunch and before it gets dark.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; evening; in the evening; night
words.exampleEnglish: I like watching TV in the evening.
words.hintSimplified: 天黑以后，大家回家休息的时候。
words.hintTraditional: 天黑以後，大家回家休息的時候。
words.hintEnglish: After dark, when people are at home resting.

words.definition: length of time; moment; period; time
words.exampleEnglish: What time are you coming home?
words.hintSimplified: 指一天里的某一刻，或人生里的某一段。
words.hintTraditional: 指一天裡的某一刻，或人生裡的某一段。
words.hintEnglish: A point within a day, or a stretch within a life.

words.exampleEnglish: My dad is a teacher.
words.hintSimplified: 家里的男性长辈，孩子这样叫他。
words.hintTraditional: 家裡的男性長輩，孩子這樣叫他。
words.hintEnglish: The male parent at home, which is what children call him.

words.exampleEnglish: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.
words.hintSimplified: 生下我并照顾我的女性，孩子这样叫她。
words.hintTraditional: 生下我並照顧我的女性，孩子這樣叫她。
words.hintEnglish: The woman who gave birth to me and takes care of me; what a child calls her.

words.exampleEnglish: My older brother is three years older than me.
words.hintSimplified: 同一对父母生的，比我年纪大的男生。
words.hintTraditional: 同一對父母生的，比我年紀大的男生。
words.hintEnglish: A boy born to the same parents who is older than me.

words.exampleEnglish: My younger brother is still in elementary school.
words.hintSimplified: 同一对父母生的，比我年纪小的男生。
words.hintTraditional: 同一對父母生的，比我年紀小的男生。
words.hintEnglish: A boy born to the same parents who is younger than me.

words.exampleEnglish: My older sister works in Taipei.
words.hintSimplified: 同一对父母生的，比我年纪大的女生。
words.hintTraditional: 同一對父母生的，比我年紀大的女生。
words.hintEnglish: A girl born to the same parents who is older than me.

words.exampleEnglish: My older sister often helps me with my homework.
words.hintSimplified: 家里比我先出生的女孩。
words.hintTraditional: 家裡比我先出生的女孩。
words.hintEnglish: The girl in the family who was born before me.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; young woman; younger sister
words.exampleEnglish: My younger sister is ten years old this year.
words.hintSimplified: 同一对父母生的，比我年纪小的女生。
words.hintTraditional: 同一對父母生的，比我年紀小的女生。
words.hintEnglish: A girl born to the same parents who is younger than me.

words.exampleEnglish: There are many children in the park.
words.hintSimplified: 年纪还很小，不是大人的人。
words.hintTraditional: 年紀還很小，不是大人的人。
words.hintEnglish: A person who is still young and not yet an adult.

words.definition: to feel (uncomfortable etc); to think that ...; to feel that ...
words.exampleEnglish: I think this dish is delicious.
words.hintSimplified: 说出自己心里的感受或想法时用的词。
words.hintTraditional: 說出自己心裡的感受或想法時用的詞。
words.hintEnglish: A word for stating what you feel or think inside.

words.gloss: to be happy; to be pleased
words.definition: to be happy; to be pleased; to like; to be fond of; to tend to
words.exampleEnglish: I like eating fruit.
words.hintSimplified: 对一个人或一件事有好感，愿意常常接近。
words.hintTraditional: 對一個人或一件事有好感，願意常常接近。
words.hintEnglish: To have good feelings toward a person or thing and want to be near it often.

words.exampleEnglish: Your new skirt is very pretty.
words.hintSimplified: 看起来让人眼睛一亮，常用来夸女生或花。
words.hintTraditional: 看起來讓人眼睛一亮，常用來誇女生或花。
words.hintEnglish: Looks so good it catches the eye; often used to praise a girl or flowers.

words.exampleEnglish: My computer is broken.
words.hintSimplified: 工作和上网都要用它，有键盘和屏幕。
words.hintTraditional: 工作和上網都要用它，有鍵盤和螢幕。
words.hintEnglish: Used for work and surfing the web; it has a keyboard and a screen.

words.exampleEnglish: The teacher writes on the blackboard.
words.hintSimplified: 在学校教学生的人。
words.hintTraditional: 在學校教學生的人。
words.hintEnglish: The person who teaches students at school.

words.exampleEnglish: There are twenty students in this class.
words.hintSimplified: 在学校念书的人。
words.hintTraditional: 在學校唸書的人。
words.hintEnglish: A person who studies at school.

words.definition: CL:所[suo3]; the Great Learning, one of the Four Books 四書|四书[Si4 shu1] in Confucianism; university; college
words.exampleEnglish: She studies Chinese at university.
words.hintSimplified: 高中毕业以后，很多人会去念的学校。
words.hintTraditional: 高中畢業以後，很多人會去唸的學校。
words.hintEnglish: The school many people go to after finishing high school.

words.exampleEnglish: Our school is very close to home.
words.hintSimplified: 老师教、学生学的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 老師教、學生學的地方。
words.hintEnglish: The place where teachers teach and students learn.

words.exampleEnglish: He speaks Chinese very well.
words.hintSimplified: 台湾和中国大陆的人说的语言。
words.hintTraditional: 台灣和中國大陸的人說的語言。
words.hintEnglish: The language spoken in Taiwan and mainland China.

words.definition: CL:位[wei4],個|个[ge4]; classmate; fellow student; to study at the same school
words.exampleEnglish: My classmates are all very friendly.
words.hintSimplified: 和你在同一个班上课的人。
words.hintTraditional: 和你在同一個班上課的人。
words.hintEnglish: People who attend the same class as you.

words.definition: able to; can; may; not bad; possible; pretty good
words.exampleEnglish: Can I sit here?
words.hintSimplified: 想得到许可，或者说“没问题”，就用这个词。
words.hintTraditional: 想得到許可，或者說“沒問題”，就用這個詞。
words.hintEnglish: Used to ask for permission or to say "no problem."

words.definition: to attend class; to go to class; to go to teach a class
words.exampleEnglish: We have class at eight.
words.hintSimplified: 老师在教室里教，学生坐着听。
words.hintTraditional: 老師在教室裡教，學生坐著聽。
words.hintEnglish: The teacher teaches in the classroom while students sit and listen.

words.definition: also pr. [zhi1dao5]; to know; to become aware of
words.exampleEnglish: I don't know where he lives.
words.hintSimplified: 对某件事有所了解，脑子里有答案。
words.hintTraditional: 對某件事有所瞭解，腦子裡有答案。
words.hintEnglish: To be aware of something; the answer is in your mind.

words.exampleEnglish: He watches TV every evening.
words.hintSimplified: 客厅里的大屏幕，可以看节目。
words.hintTraditional: 客廳裡的大螢幕，可以看節目。
words.hintEnglish: The big screen in the living room where you watch programs.

words.exampleEnglish: We go to see a movie on weekends.
words.hintSimplified: 在大屏幕上放的故事，常常一边吃爆米花一边看。
words.hintTraditional: 在大螢幕上放的故事，常常一邊吃爆米花一邊看。
words.hintEnglish: Stories shown on a huge screen, often watched while eating popcorn.

words.exampleEnglish: I used to live in Kaohsiung.
words.hintSimplified: 不是现在，而是更早的时候。
words.hintTraditional: 不是現在，而是更早的時候。
words.hintEnglish: Not now, but earlier.

words.definition: after; afterwards; following; in the future; later; later on
words.exampleEnglish: After eating, let's go for a walk.
words.hintSimplified: 一件事结束之后的时间。
words.hintTraditional: 一件事結束之後的時間。
words.hintEnglish: The time after something has finished.

words.exampleEnglish: What do you want to eat?
words.hintSimplified: 想问一样东西是哪一种时，用的疑问词。
words.hintTraditional: 想問一樣東西是哪一種時，用的疑問詞。
words.hintEnglish: The question word you use to ask what kind of thing something is.

words.exampleEnglish: She is my best friend.
words.hintSimplified: 不是家人，但是关系很好，常常一起玩的人。
words.hintTraditional: 不是家人，但是關係很好，常常一起玩的人。
words.hintEnglish: Not family, but someone close that you often hang out with.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4],件[jian4]; east and west; person; stuff; thing
words.exampleEnglish: There are many things on the table.
words.hintSimplified: 看得见、摸得到，但不知道名字时，可以这样叫它。
words.hintTraditional: 看得見、摸得到，但不知道名字時，可以這樣叫它。
words.hintEnglish: What you call a thing you can see and touch but don't know the name of.

words.exampleEnglish: See you tomorrow, goodbye!
words.hintSimplified: 离开时对别人说的话。
words.hintTraditional: 離開時對別人說的話。
words.hintEnglish: What you say to others when leaving.

words.exampleEnglish: Thank you for your help.
words.hintSimplified: 别人帮了你，你要对他说的话。
words.hintTraditional: 別人幫了你，你要對他說的話。
words.hintEnglish: What you say to someone who has helped you.

words.exampleEnglish: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
words.hintSimplified: 想礼貌地向陌生人问路时，开头说的词。
words.hintTraditional: 想禮貌地向陌生人問路時，開頭說的詞。
words.hintEnglish: The polite opening words when asking a stranger for directions.

words.gloss: abbr. for 公共汽車|公共汽车[gong1 gong4 qi4 che1]
words.definition: abbr. for 公共汽車|公共汽车[gong1 gong4 qi4 che1]; abbr. for 公務用車|公务用车[gong1 wu4 yong4 che1]; bus; car belonging to an organization and used by its members (government car, police car, company car etc)
words.exampleEnglish: I take the bus to work every day.
words.hintSimplified: 路上有站牌，很多人一起坐的大车。
words.hintTraditional: 路上有站牌，很多人一起坐的大車。
words.hintEnglish: A big vehicle with stops along the road, shared by many people.

words.gloss: car or other vehicle (bicycle, truck etc)
words.definition: car or other vehicle (bicycle, truck etc)
words.exampleEnglish: His car is red.
words.hintSimplified: 有四个轮子，可以开着去很远的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 有四個輪子，可以開著去很遠的地方。
words.hintEnglish: It has four wheels and you can drive it to far places.

words.definition: here; variant of 這裡|这里[zhe4 li3]
words.exampleEnglish: This is my home.
words.hintSimplified: 离说话的人很近的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 離說話的人很近的地方。
words.hintEnglish: A place close to the speaker.

words.exampleSimplified: 那里有一家很好吃的面馆。
words.exampleTraditional: 那裡有一家很好吃的麵館。
words.exampleEnglish: There is a very tasty noodle shop over there.
words.hintSimplified: 离说话的人比较远的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 離說話的人比較遠的地方。
words.hintEnglish: A place farther from the speaker.

words.definition: also written 哪裡|哪里; anywhere; humble expression denying compliment; nowhere (negative answer to question); somewhere; where?; wherever
words.exampleEnglish: Where do you live?
words.hintSimplified: 想知道一个地方在什么位置，会这样问。
words.hintTraditional: 想知道一個地方在什麼位置，會這樣問。
words.hintEnglish: What you ask to find out where something is.

words.gloss: (slang) to post sexual content online; to make a sexual joke
words.definition: (slang) to post sexual content online; to make a sexual joke; to drive a car (or train etc)
words.exampleEnglish: My dad drives to work.
words.hintSimplified: 坐在方向盘前，让汽车往前走。
words.hintTraditional: 坐在方向盤前，讓汽車往前走。
words.hintEnglish: Sitting at the steering wheel and making a car move forward.

words.gloss: (phone number, student ID etc) what number?
words.definition: (phone number, student ID etc) what number?; how much?; how many?; number; amount; somewhat
words.exampleEnglish: How much is this?
words.hintSimplified: 问数量或价格时用的疑问词。
words.hintTraditional: 問數量或價格時用的疑問詞。
words.hintEnglish: A question word for asking quantity or price.

words.definition: a petty advantage; cheap; inexpensive; convenient; to let sb off lightly
words.exampleEnglish: The things in this shop are very cheap.
words.hintSimplified: 价钱不高，不用花很多钱。
words.hintTraditional: 價錢不高，不用花很多錢。
words.hintEnglish: The price is low; you don't need to spend much.

words.definition: easy; straightforward; likely; liable to; apt to
words.exampleEnglish: This question is very easy.
words.hintSimplified: 不难，一下子就能做好。
words.hintTraditional: 不難，一下子就能做好。
words.hintEnglish: Not difficult; you can do it right away.

words.exampleEnglish: I want to go, but I don't have time.
words.hintSimplified: 用来连接两句话，后面的意思和前面相反。
words.hintTraditional: 用來連線兩句話，後面的意思和前面相反。
words.hintEnglish: Connects two sentences, where the second contradicts the first.

words.definition: had better; or; still (as before); unexpectedly
words.exampleEnglish: Do you want tea or coffee?
words.hintSimplified: 在选择题里，连接两个选项的词。
words.hintTraditional: 在選擇題裡，連線兩個選項的詞。
words.hintEnglish: The word linking two options in a choice question.

words.definition: doesn't exist; hasn't; haven't; to not be; to not have
words.exampleEnglish: I have no money.
words.hintSimplified: “有”的相反。
words.hintTraditional: “有”的相反。
words.hintEnglish: The opposite of "to have."

words.exampleEnglish: They have two children.
words.hintSimplified: 爸爸妈妈生的小朋友。
words.hintTraditional: 爸爸媽媽生的小朋友。
words.hintEnglish: The little ones born to a mother and father.

words.definition: (slang) prostitute; CL:個|个[ge4],位[wei4]; miss; young lady
words.exampleEnglish: Miss, what would you like to order?
words.hintSimplified: 称呼年轻女生的礼貌说法。
words.hintTraditional: 稱呼年輕女生的禮貌說法。
words.hintEnglish: A polite way to address a young woman.

words.definition: (dialect) doctor; CL:位[wei4]; gentleman; sir; mister (Mr.); husband; teacher
words.exampleEnglish: Mr. Wang is in the office.
words.hintSimplified: 称呼男士的礼貌说法。
words.hintTraditional: 稱呼男士的禮貌說法。
words.hintEnglish: A polite way to address a man.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4],位[wei4]; Madam; Mrs.; married woman; wife
words.exampleSimplified: 李太太每天去市场买菜。
words.exampleTraditional: 李太太每天去市場買菜。
words.exampleEnglish: Mrs. Li goes to the market every day to buy groceries.
words.hintSimplified: 结了婚的女士，也是别人对她的称呼。
words.hintTraditional: 結了婚的女士，也是別人對她的稱呼。
words.hintEnglish: A married woman, and a way people address her.

words.exampleEnglish: His daughter is very cute.
words.hintSimplified: 爸妈生的女孩子。
words.hintTraditional: 爸媽生的女孩子。
words.hintEnglish: The girl born to a mother and father.

words.exampleEnglish: My son likes to play soccer.
words.hintSimplified: 爸妈生的男孩子。
words.hintTraditional: 爸媽生的男孩子。
words.hintEnglish: The boy born to a mother and father.

words.exampleEnglish: Hello everyone, my name is Xiaoming.
words.hintSimplified: 在场的所有人，不是一个人。
words.hintTraditional: 在場的所有人，不是一個人。
words.hintEnglish: All the people present, not just one person.

words.definition: CL:部[bu4],臺|台[tai2]; cell phone; mobile phone
words.exampleEnglish: My cell phone is out of battery.
words.hintSimplified: 几乎每个人都放在口袋里，可以打电话也可以上网。
words.hintTraditional: 幾乎每個人都放在口袋裡，可以打電話也可以上網。
words.hintEnglish: Almost everyone keeps one in a pocket; you can call and surf the web with it.

words.exampleEnglish: Next year I want to go to Japan.
words.hintSimplified: 今年过完以后的那一年。
words.hintTraditional: 今年過完以後的那一年。
words.hintEnglish: The year after this one ends.

words.exampleEnglish: Last year we went to Taichung.
words.hintSimplified: 今年之前的那一年。
words.hintTraditional: 今年之前的那一年。
words.hintEnglish: The year before this one.

words.exampleEnglish: Today is my birthday.
words.hintSimplified: 每年一次，大家会唱歌、吃蛋糕。
words.hintTraditional: 每年一次，大家會唱歌、吃蛋糕。
words.hintEnglish: Once a year, people sing and eat cake.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; Sunday; day of the week; week
words.exampleEnglish: A week has seven days.
words.hintSimplified: 周一到周日，一共七天的一段时间。
words.hintTraditional: 週一到週日，一共七天的一段時間。
words.hintEnglish: A stretch of seven days from Monday through Sunday.

words.exampleEnglish: We're going hiking on the weekend.
words.hintSimplified: 星期六和星期日，不用上班上课。
words.hintTraditional: 星期六和星期日，不用上班上課。
words.hintEnglish: Saturday and Sunday, when there's no work or class.

words.exampleEnglish: Happy birthday to you!
words.hintSimplified: 心情很好，想笑的感觉。
words.hintTraditional: 心情很好，想笑的感覺。
words.hintEnglish: A feeling of being in a great mood, wanting to smile.

words.exampleEnglish: There are many trees and flowers in the park.
words.hintSimplified: 市民散步、小孩玩耍的绿色地方。
words.hintTraditional: 市民散步、小孩玩耍的綠色地方。
words.hintEnglish: A green place where people stroll and children play.

words.exampleSimplified: 台湾是一个美丽的国家。
words.exampleTraditional: 台灣是一個美麗的國家。
words.exampleEnglish: Taiwan is a beautiful country.
words.hintSimplified: 有自己的政府、土地和人民的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 有自己的政府、土地和人民的地方。
words.hintEnglish: A place with its own government, land, and people.

words.exampleSimplified: 我走路五分钟就到学校。
words.exampleTraditional: 我走路五分鐘就到學校。
words.exampleEnglish: It takes me five minutes to walk to school.
words.hintSimplified: 一小时有六十个。
words.hintTraditional: 一小時有六十個。
words.hintEnglish: There are sixty of them in an hour.

words.exampleEnglish: I love my family.
words.hintSimplified: 住在一起、互相照顾的亲人。
words.hintTraditional: 住在一起、互相照顧的親人。
words.hintEnglish: Relatives who live together and take care of each other.

words.exampleEnglish: I waited for you for two hours.
words.hintSimplified: 六十分钟合起来的时间，口语里常这样说。
words.hintTraditional: 六十分鐘合起來的時間，口語裡常這樣說。
words.hintEnglish: Sixty minutes put together, as people say it in everyday speech.

words.exampleEnglish: I saw the doctor the day before yesterday.
words.hintSimplified: 比昨天还要早一天。
words.hintTraditional: 比昨天還要早一天。
words.hintEnglish: One day earlier than yesterday.

words.definition: a posteriori; acquired (not innate or congenital); life after birth (the period in which one develops through experiences, contrasted with 先天[xian1 tian1]); the day after tomorrow
words.exampleEnglish: The day after tomorrow is Saturday.
words.hintSimplified: 比明天还要晚一天。
words.hintTraditional: 比明天還要晚一天。
words.hintEnglish: One day later than tomorrow.

words.exampleEnglish: The year before last, I lived in the United States.
words.hintSimplified: 去年的前一年。
words.hintTraditional: 去年的前一年。
words.hintEnglish: The year before last year.

words.exampleEnglish: I'll graduate from university the year after next.
words.hintSimplified: 明年的下一年。
words.hintTraditional: 明年的下一年。
words.hintEnglish: The year after next year.

words.exampleEnglish: I can do my homework by myself.
words.hintSimplified: 不是别人，是本人。
words.hintTraditional: 不是別人，是本人。
words.hintEnglish: Not someone else, but the person themselves.

words.exampleSimplified: 这些猫很可爱，它们喜欢睡觉。
words.exampleTraditional: 這些貓很可愛，它們喜歡睡覺。
words.exampleEnglish: These cats are cute; they like to sleep.
words.hintSimplified: 说到好几只动物或东西时用的词。
words.hintTraditional: 說到好幾只動物或東西時用的詞。
words.hintEnglish: A word used when talking about several animals or things.

words.exampleEnglish: You should go to bed earlier.
words.hintSimplified: 给别人建议时，表示这样做才对。
words.hintTraditional: 給別人建議時，表示這樣做才對。
words.hintEnglish: Used when giving advice, to say it's the right thing to do.

words.definition: (math.) proper; real; true; genuine; really; truly; indeed
words.exampleEnglish: This cake is really delicious.
words.hintSimplified: 不是假的，也不是开玩笑。
words.hintTraditional: 不是假的，也不是開玩笑。
words.hintEnglish: Not fake, and not a joke.

words.definition: (of a machine) to operate; CL:個|个[ge4],份[fen4],項|项[xiang4]; job; task; to work; work
words.exampleEnglish: He works at a bank.
words.hintSimplified: 每天上班做的事，可以赚钱。
words.hintTraditional: 每天上班做的事，可以賺錢。
words.hintEnglish: What you do at the office every day to earn money.

words.exampleEnglish: The doctor said I need to rest more.
words.hintSimplified: 生病的时候去医院找的人。
words.hintTraditional: 生病的時候去醫院找的人。
words.hintEnglish: The person you see at a hospital when you're sick.

words.exampleSimplified: 他是一位很有经验的医师。
words.exampleTraditional: 他是一位很有經驗的醫師。
words.exampleEnglish: He is a very experienced physician.
words.hintSimplified: 经过考试，有资格治疗病人的人。
words.hintTraditional: 經過考試，有資格治療病人的人。
words.hintEnglish: A person qualified by exams to treat patients.

words.gloss: (after an adjective, used to form the comparative) a bit more, -er
words.definition: (after an adjective, used to form the comparative) a bit more, -er; (calligraphy) dot stroke (、); (used in negative expressions) (not) the least bit; a bit; a little bit; a point (in a discussion etc); one o'clock (abbr. for 一點鍾|一点钟[yi1 dian3 zhong1])
words.exampleEnglish: Please speak a little more slowly.
words.hintSimplified: 表示数量很少，比“一些”还少。
words.hintTraditional: 表示數量很少，比“一些”還少。
words.hintEnglish: Indicates a very small amount, even less than "some."

words.gloss: some; a few; a little; (following an adjective) slightly ...er
words.definition: some; a few; a little; (following an adjective) slightly ...er
words.exampleEnglish: I bought some fruit.
words.hintSimplified: 不知道准确的数量，只知道不是很多。
words.hintTraditional: 不知道準確的數量，只知道不是很多。
words.hintEnglish: You don't know the exact amount, only that it's not a lot.

words.exampleEnglish: He speaks English very fluently.
words.hintSimplified: 在美国和英国使用的语言。
words.hintTraditional: 在美國和英國使用的語言。
words.hintEnglish: The language used in the United States and Britain.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; issue; problem; question; topic
words.exampleEnglish: The teacher asked us to answer a question.
words.hintSimplified: 考试里需要你回答的东西。
words.hintTraditional: 考試裡需要你回答的東西。
words.hintEnglish: What you need to answer on an exam.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; desire; fun; idea; interest; meaning; opinion; to do sth as a gesture of goodwill etc; to give as a small token; token of appreciation, affection etc; wish
words.exampleEnglish: What does this word mean?
words.hintSimplified: 查字典时，想弄清楚的内容。
words.hintTraditional: 查字典時，想弄清楚的內容。
words.hintEnglish: What you want to figure out when you look something up in a dictionary.

words.definition: CL:間|间[jian1],家[jia1]; dining hall; dining room; restaurant
words.exampleSimplified: 这家餐厅的牛肉面很好吃。
words.exampleTraditional: 這家餐廳的牛肉麵很好吃。
words.exampleEnglish: The beef noodles at this restaurant are delicious.
words.hintSimplified: 可以坐下来点菜、吃饭的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 可以坐下來點菜、吃飯的地方。
words.hintEnglish: A place where you sit down, order dishes, and eat.

words.exampleSimplified: 学校旁边有一家小饭馆。
words.exampleTraditional: 學校旁邊有一家小飯館。
words.exampleEnglish: There's a small restaurant next to the school.
words.hintSimplified: 卖饭菜给客人吃的小店。
words.hintTraditional: 賣飯菜給客人吃的小店。
words.hintEnglish: A small shop that sells meals to customers.

words.gloss: (fig.) (esp. of a sports coach) to be dismissed
words.definition: (fig.) (esp. of a sports coach) to be dismissed; to be fired; to finish class; to get out of class
words.exampleEnglish: After class we'll go eat.
words.hintSimplified: 上课结束，学生可以休息了。
words.hintTraditional: 上課結束，學生可以休息了。
words.hintEnglish: Class is over and the students can rest.

words.definition: talk; to gossip; to say; to speak; to talk; to tell stories; word
words.exampleEnglish: Please don't talk in the library.
words.hintSimplified: 用嘴巴发出声音，和别人交流。
words.hintTraditional: 用嘴巴發出聲音，和別人交流。
words.hintEnglish: Using your mouth to make sounds and communicate with others.

words.definition: CL:次[ci4]; exam; to take an exam
words.exampleEnglish: There is a Chinese exam tomorrow.
words.hintSimplified: 老师用来检查学生学得怎么样的方法。
words.hintTraditional: 老師用來檢查學生學得怎麼樣的方法。
words.hintEnglish: How teachers check what students have learned.

words.gloss: to press charges; to file a complaint
words.definition: to press charges; to file a complaint; to tell; to inform; to let know
words.exampleEnglish: Please tell me your phone number.
words.hintSimplified: 把一个消息说给别人听。
words.hintTraditional: 把一個訊息說給別人聽。
words.hintEnglish: To pass a piece of news on to someone.

words.exampleEnglish: He's waiting for me at the door.
words.hintSimplified: 房子的出入口那里。
words.hintTraditional: 房子的出入口那裡。
words.hintEnglish: The spot where you go in and out of a building.

words.exampleEnglish: The air in the mountains is very fresh.
words.hintSimplified: 看不见，但我们每天都要呼吸。
words.hintTraditional: 看不見，但我們每天都要呼吸。
words.hintEnglish: You can't see it, but we breathe it every day.

words.definition: CL:門|门[men2]; assignment; classwork; homework; lesson; study; task
words.exampleEnglish: I have a lot of homework today.
words.hintSimplified: 老师要你回家做的事。
words.hintTraditional: 老師要你回家做的事。
words.hintEnglish: What the teacher wants you to do at home.

words.exampleEnglish: There are thirty desks in the classroom.
words.hintSimplified: 学生上课坐的房间。
words.hintTraditional: 學生上課坐的房間。
words.hintEnglish: The room where students sit for lessons.

words.exampleSimplified: 请用这个词造一个句子。
words.exampleTraditional: 請用這個詞造一個句子。
words.exampleEnglish: Please make a sentence with this word.
words.hintSimplified: 几个词连起来，表示一个完整的意思。
words.hintTraditional: 幾個詞連起來，表示一個完整的意思。
words.hintEnglish: Several words linked together to express a complete meaning.

words.exampleEnglish: If you're tired, take a rest.
words.hintSimplified: 工作累了以后，停下来放松。
words.hintTraditional: 工作累了以後，停下來放鬆。
words.hintEnglish: Stopping to relax after getting tired from work.

words.exampleEnglish: It's extremely hot today.
words.hintSimplified: 比“很”还要更多。
words.hintTraditional: 比“很”還要更多。
words.hintEnglish: Even more than "very."

words.definition: CL:棟|栋[dong4],幢[zhuang4],座[zuo4],套[tao4],間|间[jian1]; apartment; building (single- or two-story); house; room
words.exampleEnglish: They bought a new house.
words.hintSimplified: 人住的建筑。
words.hintTraditional: 人住的建築。
words.hintEnglish: A building that people live in.

words.exampleEnglish: My room is on the second floor.
words.hintSimplified: 家里睡觉的那一个小空间。
words.hintTraditional: 家裡睡覺的那一個小空間。
words.hintEnglish: The little space at home where you sleep.

words.exampleEnglish: The book is on the table.
words.hintSimplified: 吃饭或写字时，东西放在上面。
words.hintTraditional: 吃飯或寫字時，東西放在上面。
words.hintEnglish: Where you put things when eating or writing.

words.exampleEnglish: Please sit on this chair.
words.hintSimplified: 有四条腿，可以坐。
words.hintTraditional: 有四條腿，可以坐。
words.hintEnglish: It has four legs and you sit on it.

words.definition: correct; not bad; pretty good; right
words.exampleEnglish: The coffee at this shop is pretty good.
words.hintSimplified: 不是特别好，但也不差，是称赞别人的话。
words.hintTraditional: 不是特別好，但也不差，是稱讚別人的話。
words.hintEnglish: Not outstanding, but certainly not bad; a form of praise.

words.exampleEnglish: The weather is very nice today.
words.hintSimplified: 晴天、下雨、刮风，都是它的变化。
words.hintTraditional: 晴天、下雨、颳風，都是它的變化。
words.hintEnglish: Sunny, rainy, windy: these are its changes.

words.exampleEnglish: It's raining outside, take an umbrella.
words.hintSimplified: 天上掉下水，需要带伞。
words.hintTraditional: 天上掉下水，需要帶傘。
words.hintEnglish: Water falls from the sky, so you need an umbrella.

words.definition: CL:首[shou3]; style of folk song popular in Gansu, Qinghai and Ningxia
words.exampleEnglish: In spring all the flowers bloom.
words.hintSimplified: 美丽、有香味，常常插在花瓶里。
words.hintTraditional: 美麗、有香味，常常插在花瓶裡。
words.hintEnglish: Beautiful and fragrant, often put in a vase.

words.exampleEnglish: I drink a cup of coffee in the morning.
words.hintSimplified: 黑黑的热饮，喝了可以不想睡觉。
words.hintTraditional: 黑黑的熱飲，喝了可以不想睡覺。
words.hintEnglish: A dark hot drink that keeps you from feeling sleepy.

words.gloss: to get out of bed; to get up
words.definition: to get out of bed; to get up
words.exampleEnglish: I get up at six every day.
words.hintSimplified: 早上睡醒以后，离开床。
words.hintTraditional: 早上睡醒以後，離開床。
words.hintEnglish: After waking up in the morning, leaving the bed.

words.definition: (euphemism) to relieve oneself; convenient; suitable; having money to spare; to facilitate; to make things easy
words.exampleEnglish: Living near a station is very convenient.
words.hintSimplified: 做事很轻松，不用花太多力气。
words.hintTraditional: 做事很輕鬆，不用花太多力氣。
words.hintEnglish: Easy to do; you don't need to put in much effort.

words.definition: to go to bed; to sleep
words.exampleEnglish: I go to sleep at ten at night.
words.hintSimplified: 闭上眼睛，在床上休息一整夜。
words.hintTraditional: 閉上眼睛，在床上休息一整夜。
words.hintEnglish: Closing your eyes and resting in bed all night.

words.gloss: (after a perception verb, e.g. 看[kan4]) expressing preliminary judgment
words.definition: (after a perception verb, e.g. 看[kan4]) expressing preliminary judgment; (after a verb) indicating the beginning and continuation of an action or a state; also pr. [qi3lai2]; also pr. [qi3lai5]; indicating an upward movement (e.g. after 站[zhan4]); indicating completion; to stand up; to get up
words.exampleEnglish: Please stand up.
words.hintSimplified: 跟在动词后面，表示从下往上，或开始做一件事。
words.hintTraditional: 跟在動詞後面，表示從下往上，或開始做一件事。
words.hintEnglish: Follows a verb to show upward movement or the start of an action.

words.exampleEnglish: He is often late.
words.hintSimplified: 一个星期好几次，不是偶尔。
words.hintTraditional: 一個星期好幾次，不是偶爾。
words.hintEnglish: Several times a week, not just occasionally.

words.definition: CL:場|场[chang3]; campaign; exercise; motion; movement; sports; to exercise; to move
words.exampleSimplified: 我每天早上运动三十分钟。
words.exampleTraditional: 我每天早上運動三十分鐘。
words.exampleEnglish: I exercise for thirty minutes every morning.
words.hintSimplified: 跑步、游泳、打球，都是这类活动。
words.hintTraditional: 跑步、游泳、打球，都是這類活動。
words.hintEnglish: Running, swimming, and playing ball are all this kind of activity.

words.gloss: (informal) to clear off; to beat it
words.definition: (informal) to clear off; to beat it; (of sb who gets fired or resigns) to leave the job; to get out; to leave; to depart; to walk; to go on foot
words.exampleEnglish: I walk to school.
words.hintSimplified: 不坐车，用两只脚去一个地方。
words.hintTraditional: 不坐車，用兩隻腳去一個地方。
words.hintEnglish: Not taking a vehicle, but using your two feet to get somewhere.

words.exampleEnglish: She loves singing.
words.hintSimplified: 用声音唱出旋律，KTV里很常见。
words.hintTraditional: 用聲音唱出旋律，KTV裡很常見。
words.hintEnglish: Making melodies with your voice; very common at karaoke.

words.exampleEnglish: They are dancing on the stage.
words.hintSimplified: 随着音乐动身体。
words.hintTraditional: 隨著音樂動身體。
words.hintEnglish: Moving your body to music.

words.definition: introduction; to give a presentation; to introduce (sb to sb); to present (sb for a job etc)
words.exampleSimplified: 我来介绍一下，这是我朋友。
words.exampleTraditional: 我來介紹一下，這是我朋友。
words.exampleEnglish: Let me introduce you; this is my friend.
words.hintSimplified: 让两个不认识的人互相认识。
words.hintTraditional: 讓兩個不認識的人互相認識。
words.hintEnglish: Helping two people who don't know each other get acquainted.

words.definition: how?; variant of 怎麼|怎么[zen3 me5]; what?; why?
words.exampleEnglish: How do you pronounce this character?
words.hintSimplified: 问做事的方法或原因时用的词。
words.hintTraditional: 問做事的方法或原因時用的詞。
words.hintEnglish: A word for asking about a method or a reason.

words.definition: also pr. [li3 mian5]; inside; interior; variant of 裡面|里面[li3 mian4]
words.exampleEnglish: There's a pen inside the box.
words.hintSimplified: 在一个东西的内部。
words.hintTraditional: 在一個東西的內部。
words.hintEnglish: On the inner part of something.

words.definition: above-mentioned; also pr. [shang4 mian5]; on top of
words.exampleEnglish: The book is on top of the table.
words.hintSimplified: 在一个东西比较高的那一边。
words.hintTraditional: 在一個東西比較高的那一邊。
words.hintEnglish: On the higher side of something.

words.definition: also pr. [xia4 mian5]; below; next; the following; to boil noodles; under
words.exampleEnglish: The chair is under the table.
words.hintSimplified: 在一个东西底下的位置。
words.hintTraditional: 在一個東西底下的位置。
words.hintEnglish: The position beneath something.

words.definition: exterior; external appearance; outside (also pr. [wai4 mian5] for this sense); surface
words.exampleEnglish: It's raining outside.
words.hintSimplified: 不在房间里，在墙的另一边。
words.hintTraditional: 不在房間裡，在牆的另一邊。
words.hintEnglish: Not in the room, but on the other side of the walls.

words.exampleEnglish: It's cold outside, wear more.
words.hintSimplified: 口语里，指房子以外的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 口語裡，指房子以外的地方。
words.hintEnglish: In casual speech, the place beyond the house.

words.definition: above; ahead; also pr. [qian2 mian5]; in front; preceding
words.exampleEnglish: The school is up ahead.
words.hintSimplified: 面对的方向，不是后背那一边。
words.hintTraditional: 面對的方向，不是後背那一邊。
words.hintEnglish: The direction you face, not the side behind your back.

words.gloss: behind; near the end; at the back
words.definition: behind; near the end; at the back; later; afterwards; the back; the rear; the last bit
words.exampleEnglish: He sits behind me.
words.hintSimplified: 背对的方向，和前面相反。
words.hintTraditional: 背對的方向，和前面相反。
words.hintEnglish: The direction at your back, the opposite of front.

words.definition: left; the left side; to the left of
words.exampleEnglish: The restroom is on the left.
words.hintSimplified: 多数人不拿笔的那只手所在的一边。
words.hintTraditional: 多數人不拿筆的那隻手所在的一邊。
words.hintEnglish: The side of the hand that most people don't write with.

words.definition: right side; right, to the right
words.exampleEnglish: Please walk on the right side.
words.hintSimplified: 多数人写字那只手所在的一边。
words.hintTraditional: 多數人寫字那隻手所在的一邊。
words.hintEnglish: The side of the hand most people write with.

words.exampleEnglish: The bank is next to the post office.
words.hintSimplified: 紧紧靠着某个东西的位置。
words.hintTraditional: 緊緊靠著某個東西的位置。
words.hintEnglish: A position right up against something.

words.definition: CL:處|处[chu4]; aspect; part; local; place; location; area; space; territory; region; regional (away from the central administration)
words.exampleEnglish: This is a very quiet place.
words.hintSimplified: 可以去、可以待的某个位置。
words.hintTraditional: 可以去、可以待的某個位置。
words.hintEnglish: Some spot where you can go or stay.

words.exampleSimplified: 我家附近有一家便利商店。
words.exampleTraditional: 我家附近有一家便利商店。
words.exampleEnglish: There's a convenience store near my home.
words.hintSimplified: 离一个地方不远的区域。
words.hintTraditional: 離一個地方不遠的區域。
words.hintEnglish: The area not far from a location.

words.exampleEnglish: We're taking the train to Taipei.
words.hintSimplified: 在铁轨上跑的长长的交通工具。
words.hintTraditional: 在鐵軌上跑的長長的交通工具。
words.hintEnglish: A long vehicle that runs on rails.

words.exampleEnglish: What time does the plane take off?
words.hintSimplified: 在天上飞，去外国要坐它。
words.hintTraditional: 在天上飛，去外國要坐它。
words.hintEnglish: It flies in the sky; you take it to go abroad.

words.exampleEnglish: He wants to study abroad.
words.hintSimplified: 不是自己的国家，是别的国家。
words.hintTraditional: 不是自己的國家，是別的國家。
words.hintEnglish: A country other than your own.

words.exampleEnglish: Exercise is good for the body.
words.hintSimplified: 从头到脚，我们整个人的样子。
words.hintTraditional: 從頭到腳，我們整個人的樣子。
words.hintEnglish: From head to toe, the whole physical form of a person.

words.exampleEnglish: Her eyes are big and bright.
words.hintSimplified: 用来看东西的器官。
words.hintTraditional: 用來看東西的器官。
words.hintEnglish: The organ used for seeing.

words.exampleEnglish: My nose is stuffed up.
words.hintSimplified: 在脸中间，用来闻味道。
words.hintTraditional: 在臉中間，用來聞味道。
words.hintEnglish: In the middle of the face, used to smell.

words.definition: CL:隻|只[zhi1],個|个[ge4],對|对[dui4]; ear; handle (on a cup)
words.exampleEnglish: He has sharp ears.
words.hintSimplified: 长在头两边，用来听声音。
words.hintTraditional: 長在頭兩邊，用來聽聲音。
words.hintEnglish: On both sides of the head, used to hear sounds.

words.definition: (Tw) to detest; (coll.) to be interested in (often used in the negative); (common) cold; CL:場|场[chang2],次[ci4]; can't stand; to catch cold
words.exampleEnglish: I caught a cold and keep coughing.
words.hintSimplified: 天气变冷时容易得的小病，会流鼻涕。
words.hintTraditional: 天氣變冷時容易得的小病，會流鼻涕。
words.hintEnglish: A minor illness easily caught in cold weather, with a runny nose.

words.exampleEnglish: He's sick and can't come today.
words.hintSimplified: 身体不舒服，需要看医生。
words.hintTraditional: 身體不舒服，需要看醫生。
words.hintEnglish: Your body feels unwell and you need to see a doctor.

words.definition: mouth (CL:張|张[zhang1]); slap in the face
words.exampleEnglish: Please open your mouth.
words.hintSimplified: 吃东西和说话用的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 吃東西和說話用的地方。
words.hintEnglish: The part used for eating and talking.

words.definition: to see a patient; to visit a doctor
words.exampleEnglish: He went to the hospital to see a doctor.
words.hintSimplified: 身体不好，去找医生检查。
words.hintTraditional: 身體不好，去找醫生檢查。
words.hintEnglish: When your health is poor, you go to a doctor for an examination.

words.exampleEnglish: I want to buy a new pair of shoes.
words.hintSimplified: 穿在脚上，出门前要穿好。
words.hintTraditional: 穿在腳上，出門前要穿好。
words.hintEnglish: Worn on the feet; you put them on before going out.

words.exampleEnglish: This piece of clothing is very pretty.
words.hintSimplified: 穿在身上，天冷时要多穿几件。
words.hintTraditional: 穿在身上，天冷時要多穿幾件。
words.hintEnglish: Worn on your body; wear more layers when it's cold.

words.definition: equal to; just like; like; same; the same as
words.exampleEnglish: Your bag is the same as mine.
words.hintSimplified: 两个东西没有不同。
words.hintTraditional: 兩個東西沒有不同。
words.hintEnglish: Two things having no difference.

words.gloss: to see; to catch sight of
words.definition: to see; to catch sight of
words.exampleEnglish: I saw my teacher on the road.
words.hintSimplified: 东西进入了你的视线。
words.hintTraditional: 東西進入了你的視線。
words.hintEnglish: Something comes into your field of view.

words.exampleEnglish: I heard someone singing.
words.hintSimplified: 耳朵接收到了声音。
words.hintTraditional: 耳朵接收到了聲音。
words.hintEnglish: Your ears pick up a sound.

words.exampleEnglish: These come to 500 dollars in total.
words.hintSimplified: 把所有东西的数量加起来。
words.hintTraditional: 把所有東西的數量加起來。
words.hintEnglish: Adding up the amounts of everything.

words.exampleEnglish: He eats with chopsticks.
words.hintSimplified: 两根细长的小棍，亚洲人吃饭常用。
words.hintTraditional: 兩根細長的小棍，亞洲人吃飯常用。
words.hintEnglish: Two long thin sticks that many Asians use to eat.

words.exampleEnglish: It's a little cold today.
words.hintSimplified: 程度不深，常用在不太好的事情前面。
words.hintTraditional: 程度不深，常用在不太好的事情前面。
words.hintEnglish: A mild degree, often used before something slightly negative.

words.exampleEnglish: Please give me a cup.
words.hintSimplified: 用来装水或茶，可以拿着喝。
words.hintTraditional: 用來裝水或茶，可以拿著喝。
words.hintEnglish: Holds water or tea and you drink from it.

words.exampleSimplified: 夜市有很多好吃的小吃。
words.exampleTraditional: 夜市有很多好吃的小吃。
words.exampleEnglish: The night market has lots of tasty snacks.
words.hintSimplified: 夜市里常见的、份量不大的食物。
words.hintTraditional: 夜市裡常見的、份量不大的食物。
words.hintEnglish: Small-portion food common at night markets.

words.exampleSimplified: 我每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
words.exampleTraditional: 我每天早上喝一杯牛奶。
words.exampleEnglish: I drink a glass of milk every morning.
words.hintSimplified: 从母牛身上来的白色饮料。
words.hintTraditional: 從母牛身上來的白色飲料。
words.hintEnglish: A white drink that comes from cows.

words.exampleSimplified: 过年的时候我们吃饺子。
words.exampleTraditional: 過年的時候我們吃餃子。
words.exampleEnglish: We eat dumplings at New Year.
words.hintSimplified: 用薄皮包肉和菜，煮熟或煎熟来吃。
words.hintTraditional: 用薄皮包肉和菜，煮熟或煎熟來吃。
words.hintEnglish: Thin dough wrapped around meat and vegetables, boiled or pan-fried.

words.exampleEnglish: I ate two baozi for breakfast.
words.hintSimplified: 圆圆的白色面团，里面有肉或菜，用蒸的。
words.hintTraditional: 圓圓的白色麵糰，裡面有肉或菜，用蒸的。
words.hintEnglish: Round white dough with meat or vegetables inside, cooked by steaming.

words.exampleEnglish: You eat cake on your birthday.
words.hintSimplified: 甜甜软软，上面常常插蜡烛。
words.hintTraditional: 甜甜軟軟，上面常常插蠟燭。
words.hintEnglish: Sweet and soft, often topped with candles.

words.exampleEnglish: I eat bread and milk for breakfast.
words.hintSimplified: 用面粉烤成的，常常夹着东西吃。
words.hintTraditional: 用麵粉烤成的，常常夾著東西吃。
words.hintEnglish: Baked from flour, often eaten with a filling.

words.exampleEnglish: I like eating fresh fruit.
words.hintSimplified: 苹果、香蕉、西瓜都属于这一类。
words.hintTraditional: 蘋果、香蕉、西瓜都屬於這一類。
words.hintEnglish: Apples, bananas, and watermelons all belong to this group.

words.exampleEnglish: Monkeys like eating bananas.
words.hintSimplified: 黄色长长的，要剥皮才能吃。
words.hintTraditional: 黃色長長的，要剝皮才能吃。
words.hintEnglish: Yellow and long; you peel it before eating.

words.exampleSimplified: 台湾有很多好吃的食物。
words.exampleTraditional: 台灣有很多好吃的食物。
words.exampleEnglish: Taiwan has lots of delicious food.
words.hintSimplified: 所有可以吃的东西。
words.hintTraditional: 所有可以吃的東西。
words.hintEnglish: Anything that can be eaten.

words.exampleEnglish: What drink would you like?
words.hintSimplified: 咖啡、茶、果汁都属于这一类。
words.hintTraditional: 咖啡、茶、果汁都屬於這一類。
words.hintEnglish: Coffee, tea, and juice all belong to this group.

words.exampleEnglish: I'd like a glass of orange juice.
words.hintSimplified: 把水果榨出来的水。
words.hintTraditional: 把水果榨出來的水。
words.hintEnglish: The liquid squeezed from fruit.

words.exampleEnglish: The waiter gave us the menu.
words.hintSimplified: 餐厅里写着有哪些菜的纸。
words.hintTraditional: 餐廳裡寫著有哪些菜的紙。
words.hintEnglish: The paper in a restaurant listing the dishes.

words.definition: (in) the same place; altogether; in total; an instance of; a case of (murder, accident, dispute etc); together; in company (with)
words.exampleEnglish: Let's go together.
words.hintSimplified: 不是一个人，大家一块儿做。
words.hintTraditional: 不是一個人，大家一塊兒做。
words.hintEnglish: Not alone; everyone does it side by side.

words.gloss: because; owing to; on account of
words.definition: because; owing to; on account of
words.exampleSimplified: 因为下雨，所以我没出门。
words.exampleTraditional: 因為下雨，所以我沒出門。
words.exampleEnglish: Because it was raining, I didn't go out.
words.hintSimplified: 用来说明原因的词。
words.hintTraditional: 用來說明原因的詞。
words.hintEnglish: A word used to give a reason.

words.definition: as a result; so; the reason why; therefore
words.exampleEnglish: I'm tired, so I'm going to bed early.
words.hintSimplified: 说明结果时用的词。
words.hintTraditional: 說明結果時用的詞。
words.hintEnglish: A word used to state a result.

words.definition: a certain ...; a given ...; fixed; settled; surely; certainly; definitely
words.exampleEnglish: I will definitely come tomorrow.
words.hintSimplified: 没有怀疑，百分之百肯定。
words.hintTraditional: 沒有懷疑，百分之百肯定。
words.hintEnglish: No doubt, one hundred percent sure.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; maybe; might (happen); perhaps; possibility; possible; probability; probable
words.exampleEnglish: It might rain tomorrow.
words.hintSimplified: 也许会发生，但不是百分之百。
words.hintTraditional: 也許會發生，但不是百分之百。
words.hintEnglish: Perhaps it will happen, but it's not certain.

words.definition: at once; immediately; on horseback (i.e. by military force); right away
words.exampleEnglish: Please wait a moment, I'll be right there.
words.hintSimplified: 不用等很久，立刻就做。
words.hintTraditional: 不用等很久，立刻就做。
words.hintEnglish: No long wait; you do it right away.

words.exampleEnglish: First eat, and then see a movie.
words.hintSimplified: 说完第一件事，接着说下一件事。
words.hintTraditional: 說完第一件事，接著說下一件事。
words.hintEnglish: After the first thing, you go on to the next.

words.exampleEnglish: My grandfather lives in the countryside.
words.hintSimplified: 爸爸的爸爸。
words.hintTraditional: 爸爸的爸爸。
words.hintEnglish: Dad's dad.

words.definition: (coll.) boobies; (informal) grandma (paternal grandmother); (respectful) mistress of the house; CL:位[wei4]; breasts
words.exampleEnglish: The dishes my grandma makes are delicious.
words.hintSimplified: 爸爸的妈妈。
words.hintTraditional: 爸爸的媽媽。
words.hintEnglish: Dad's mom.

words.exampleEnglish: I have a happy family.
words.hintSimplified: 爸爸、妈妈和孩子组成的小团体。
words.hintTraditional: 爸爸、媽媽和孩子組成的小團體。
words.hintEnglish: The small group made up of parents and children.

words.exampleEnglish: Don't speak ill of others.
words.hintSimplified: 不是我，也不是你，是其他的人。
words.hintTraditional: 不是我，也不是你，是其他的人。
words.hintEnglish: Not me and not you, but other people.

words.definition: adult; grownup; title of respect toward superiors
words.exampleEnglish: Children should listen to adults.
words.hintSimplified: 已经长大，不再是小孩的人。
words.hintTraditional: 已經長大，不再是小孩的人。
words.hintEnglish: Someone who has grown up and is no longer a child.

words.definition: old man or woman; one's aged parents or grandparents; the elderly
words.exampleEnglish: Please give up your seat to the elderly.
words.hintSimplified: 头发白了，年纪很大的人。
words.hintTraditional: 頭髮白了，年紀很大的人。
words.hintEnglish: A person with white hair and of great age.

words.exampleEnglish: She looks very young.
words.hintSimplified: 年纪不大，充满活力。
words.hintTraditional: 年紀不大，充滿活力。
words.hintEnglish: Not far along in years and full of energy.

words.definition: boy; guy (young adult male); male student; schoolboy
words.exampleEnglish: There are fifteen boys in our class.
words.hintSimplified: 学校里性别为男的年轻人。
words.hintTraditional: 學校裡性別為男的年輕人。
words.hintEnglish: A young person at school who is male.

words.exampleEnglish: She's a girl in our class.
words.hintSimplified: 学校里性别为女的年轻人。
words.hintTraditional: 學校裡性別為女的年輕人。
words.hintEnglish: A young person at school who is female.

words.exampleSimplified: 请告诉我你的电话号码。
words.exampleTraditional: 請告訴我你的電話號碼。
words.exampleEnglish: Please tell me your phone number.
words.hintSimplified: 电话、门牌、座位上面都有的一串数字。
words.hintTraditional: 電話、門牌、座位上面都有的一串數字。
words.hintEnglish: The string of digits found on phones, doors, and seats.

words.exampleEnglish: Please write down your address.
words.hintSimplified: 寄信时要写，告诉别人你住在哪里。
words.hintTraditional: 寄信時要寫，告訴別人你住在哪裡。
words.hintEnglish: Written when you send a letter, telling people where you live.

words.exampleEnglish: Taipei is a big city.
words.hintSimplified: 人很多，有高楼和马路的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 人很多，有高樓和馬路的地方。
words.hintEnglish: A place with many people, tall buildings, and roads.

words.definition: (coll.) Sunday; (coll.) week; to attend a religious service
words.exampleEnglish: I have an exam next week.
words.hintSimplified: 七天为一轮，口语里常用。
words.hintTraditional: 七天為一輪，口語裡常用。
words.hintEnglish: A cycle of seven days, common in everyday speech.

words.definition: formerly; once upon a time; previously
words.exampleEnglish: Once upon a time there was a mountain.
words.hintSimplified: 讲故事的开头，指很久以前。
words.hintTraditional: 講故事的開頭，指很久以前。
words.hintEnglish: The opening of a story, referring to long ago.

words.definition: just a moment ago; just recently
words.exampleEnglish: I just got home.
words.hintSimplified: 一分钟以前才发生。
words.hintTraditional: 一分鐘以前才發生。
words.hintEnglish: Happened just a minute ago.

words.definition: a moment; a while; also pr. [yi1 hui3]; in a moment
words.exampleEnglish: Please wait for me for a little while.
words.hintSimplified: 很短的一段时间。
words.hintTraditional: 很短的一段時間。
words.hintEnglish: A very short stretch of time.

words.exampleEnglish: They're getting married next year.
words.hintSimplified: 两个人在婚礼上成为夫妻。
words.hintTraditional: 兩個人在婚禮上成為夫妻。
words.hintEnglish: Two people become husband and wife at a wedding.

words.exampleEnglish: In spring the flowers all bloom.
words.hintSimplified: 一年的第一个季节，天气变暖。
words.hintTraditional: 一年的第一個季節，天氣變暖。
words.hintEnglish: The first season of the year, when the weather warms up.

words.exampleSimplified: 夏天很热，大家喜欢游泳。
words.exampleTraditional: 夏天很熱，大家喜歡游泳。
words.exampleEnglish: Summer is hot and everyone likes to swim.
words.hintSimplified: 一年中最热的季节。
words.hintTraditional: 一年中最熱的季節。
words.hintEnglish: The hottest season of the year.

words.exampleEnglish: Leaves turn yellow in autumn.
words.hintSimplified: 叶子变黄、天气转凉的季节。
words.hintTraditional: 葉子變黃、天氣轉涼的季節。
words.hintEnglish: The season when leaves turn yellow and the weather cools.

words.exampleEnglish: You need to wear a thick coat in winter.
words.hintSimplified: 一年中最冷的季节。
words.hintTraditional: 一年中最冷的季節。
words.hintEnglish: The coldest season of the year.

words.definition: glad; happy; in a cheerful mood; willing (to do sth)
words.exampleEnglish: I'm happy to meet you.
words.hintSimplified: 心情好，脸上有笑容。
words.hintTraditional: 心情好，臉上有笑容。
words.hintEnglish: In a good mood, with a smile on your face.

words.definition: CL:陣|阵[zhen4]; in short supply; intense; keyed up; nervous; scarce; strained; tense
words.exampleEnglish: I'm nervous before exams.
words.hintSimplified: 心跳很快，手心流汗的感觉。
words.hintTraditional: 心跳很快，手心流汗的感覺。
words.hintEnglish: A feeling of racing heart and sweaty palms.

words.exampleEnglish: This puppy is so cute.
words.hintSimplified: 小孩和小动物让人喜欢的样子。
words.hintTraditional: 小孩和小動物讓人喜歡的樣子。
words.hintEnglish: How children and small animals look that makes people adore them.

words.gloss: to get angry; to be furious
words.definition: to get angry; to be furious; vitality; liveliness
words.exampleEnglish: Mom is angry.
words.hintSimplified: 心里很不高兴，脸可能会变红。
words.hintTraditional: 心裡很不高興，臉可能會變紅。
words.hintEnglish: Very upset inside, with your face possibly turning red.

words.definition: (of life) to be difficult; to feel sad; to feel unwell
words.exampleSimplified: 听到这个消息，我很难过。
words.exampleTraditional: 聽到這個訊息，我很難過。
words.exampleEnglish: I was sad to hear the news.
words.hintSimplified: 心里不好受，想哭。
words.hintTraditional: 心裡不好受，想哭。
words.hintEnglish: Hurting inside and wanting to cry.

words.definition: acute (of sight and hearing); intelligent; clever; bright
words.exampleEnglish: This child is very smart.
words.hintSimplified: 脑筋转得快，学东西很快。
words.hintTraditional: 腦筋轉得快，學東西很快。
words.hintEnglish: Quick thinking and fast at learning.

words.gloss: to believe; to be convinced; to accept as true
words.definition: to believe; to be convinced; to accept as true
words.exampleEnglish: I believe what you say.
words.hintSimplified: 觉得别人说的是真的，不怀疑。
words.hintTraditional: 覺得別人說的是真的，不懷疑。
words.hintEnglish: Feeling that what someone says is true, without doubt.

words.definition: experience; to go through; to experience
words.exampleEnglish: He has a lot of work experience.
words.hintSimplified: 做过很多次以后得到的知识。
words.hintTraditional: 做過很多次以後得到的知識。
words.hintEnglish: Knowledge gained after doing something many times.

words.definition: arduous; exhausting; hard; hardship(s); to go to a lot of trouble; to work hard; tough
words.exampleEnglish: Work was tough today.
words.hintSimplified: 做事很累，花了很多力气。
words.hintTraditional: 做事很累，花了很多力氣。
words.hintEnglish: Doing something tiring that takes a lot of effort.

words.definition: ready; to want; to wish; willing (to do sth)
words.exampleEnglish: I'm willing to help you.
words.hintSimplified: 心里同意，不用别人逼你。
words.hintTraditional: 心裡同意，不用別人逼你。
words.hintEnglish: Agreeing in your heart without anyone forcing you.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; custom; habit; to be used to; usual practice
words.exampleEnglish: Getting up early is a good habit.
words.hintSimplified: 每天重复做，不用想就会做的事。
words.hintTraditional: 每天重複做，不用想就會做的事。
words.hintEnglish: Something you repeat daily and do without thinking.

words.definition: as it should be; certainly; of course; only natural; without doubt
words.exampleEnglish: Do you want to go? Of course!
words.hintSimplified: 回答“没问题”时，表示这是应该的。
words.hintTraditional: 回答“沒問題”時，表示這是應該的。
words.hintEnglish: Said when answering "no problem," meaning it's only natural.

words.exampleEnglish: He works at a hospital.
words.hintSimplified: 生病的人去的大建筑，里面有医生和护士。
words.hintTraditional: 生病的人去的大建築，裡面有醫生和護士。
words.hintEnglish: A large building people go to when sick, with doctors and nurses.

words.exampleEnglish: I work at a large company.
words.hintSimplified: 很多人一起上班赚钱的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 很多人一起上班賺錢的地方。
words.hintEnglish: A place where many people work together and earn money.

words.exampleEnglish: There are many workers in the factory.
words.hintSimplified: 在工厂或工地做粗活的人。
words.hintTraditional: 在工廠或工地做粗活的人。
words.hintEnglish: A person doing manual work at a factory or construction site.

words.exampleEnglish: The nurse is taking care of the patient.
words.hintSimplified: 在医院帮医生照顾病人的人，通常穿白衣服。
words.hintTraditional: 在醫院幫醫生照顧病人的人，通常穿白衣服。
words.hintEnglish: A person who helps the doctor take care of patients at a hospital, often in white.

words.exampleEnglish: The driver drives very steadily.
words.hintSimplified: 靠开车赚钱的人。
words.hintTraditional: 靠開車賺錢的人。
words.hintEnglish: A person who earns a living by driving.

words.definition: Robam (brand); boss; proprietor; variant of 老闆|老板[lao3 ban3]
words.exampleEnglish: Our boss is very nice.
words.hintSimplified: 开公司或开店，给员工发钱的人。
words.hintTraditional: 開公司或開店，給員工發錢的人。
words.hintEnglish: A person who runs a company or shop and pays the staff.

words.definition: to be on duty; to go to the office; to go to work; to start work
words.exampleEnglish: I start work at eight.
words.hintSimplified: 早上去公司开始工作。
words.hintTraditional: 早上去公司開始工作。
words.hintEnglish: Going to the office in the morning to begin work.

words.definition: next service (train, bus etc); to finish work; to get off work
words.exampleEnglish: I get off work at six.
words.hintSimplified: 工作做完了，回家。
words.hintTraditional: 工作做完了，回家。
words.hintEnglish: The day's work is done and you head home.

words.exampleEnglish: He has strong work ability.
words.hintSimplified: 一个人能做好事情的本事。
words.hintTraditional: 一個人能做好事情的本事。
words.hintEnglish: A person's capacity to get things done well.

words.definition: hard-working; conscientious; to make an effort; to try hard; to strive
words.exampleEnglish: She studies Chinese very diligently.
words.hintSimplified: 用尽力气去做，不偷懒。
words.hintTraditional: 用盡力氣去做，不偷懶。
words.hintEnglish: Putting in all your strength and not slacking off.

words.definition: preparation; reserve (fund); to be about to; to intend; to prepare
words.exampleEnglish: I'm preparing for tomorrow's exam.
words.hintSimplified: 事情开始做以前，先把东西弄好。
words.hintTraditional: 事情開始做以前，先把東西弄好。
words.hintEnglish: Getting things ready before starting something.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; calculation; intention; plan; to calculate; to intend; to plan
words.exampleEnglish: What do you plan to do this weekend?
words.hintSimplified: 心里想好以后要怎么做。
words.hintTraditional: 心裡想好以後要怎麼做。
words.hintEnglish: Having worked out in your mind what to do later.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4],項|项[xiang4]; plan; program; project; to map out; to plan
words.exampleEnglish: We have a travel plan.
words.hintSimplified: 事先写好的步骤和时间安排。
words.hintTraditional: 事先寫好的步驟和時間安排。
words.hintEnglish: Steps and a schedule worked out in advance.

words.exampleEnglish: I want to find an opportunity to go to Japan.
words.hintSimplified: 刚好可以做一件好事的时候。
words.hintTraditional: 剛好可以做一件好事的時候。
words.hintEnglish: A moment when you happen to be able to do something good.

words.gloss: if; in case; in the event that
words.definition: if; in case; in the event that
words.exampleSimplified: 如果明天下雨，我们就不去了。
words.exampleTraditional: 如果明天下雨，我們就不去了。
words.exampleEnglish: If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
words.hintSimplified: 用在句子开头，假设一件事发生。
words.hintTraditional: 用在句子開頭，假設一件事發生。
words.hintEnglish: Used at the start of a sentence to suppose something happens.

words.exampleEnglish: My younger brother is in elementary school.
words.hintSimplified: 六岁的孩子开始上的学校。
words.hintTraditional: 六歲的孩子開始上的學校。
words.hintEnglish: The school children start at around six years old.

words.gloss: senior high school (abbr. for 高級中學|高级中学[gao1 ji2 zhong1 xue2])
words.definition: senior high school (abbr. for 高級中學|高级中学[gao1 ji2 zhong1 xue2]); to pass brilliantly (used in congratulatory fashion)
words.exampleEnglish: He will start high school next year.
words.hintSimplified: 国中毕业以后念的学校。
words.hintTraditional: 國中畢業以後唸的學校。
words.hintEnglish: The school you attend after junior high.

words.definition: to attend school; to go to school
words.exampleEnglish: I walk to school every day.
words.hintSimplified: 早上背着书包去学校。
words.hintTraditional: 早上揹著書包去學校。
words.hintEnglish: Carrying your school bag to school in the morning.

words.definition: (of a semester) to begin; (of a student) to start school; (old) to found a school; the start of a new term
words.exampleEnglish: School starts in September; I'm looking forward to it.
words.hintSimplified: 暑假结束，新的学期开始。
words.hintTraditional: 暑假結束，新的學期開始。
words.hintEnglish: Summer break ends and the new term begins.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; grade; year (in school, college etc)
words.exampleEnglish: My son is in third grade.
words.hintSimplified: 学校里按几年来分的班别。
words.hintTraditional: 學校裡按幾年來分的班別。
words.hintEnglish: The level in school based on years of study.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; homework; operation; school assignment; task; to operate; work
words.exampleEnglish: There's a lot of homework today.
words.hintSimplified: 老师发给学生回家写的东西。
words.hintTraditional: 老師發給學生回家寫的東西。
words.hintEnglish: What the teacher hands out for students to complete at home.

words.definition: CL:項|项[xiang4],個|个[ge4]; achievement; grades; performance records
words.exampleEnglish: His grades are very good.
words.hintSimplified: 考试以后得到的分数。
words.hintTraditional: 考試以後得到的分數。
words.hintEnglish: The marks you get after an exam.

words.exampleEnglish: I want to learn a new language.
words.hintSimplified: 中文、英文、日文都是它。
words.hintTraditional: 中文、英文、日文都是它。
words.hintEnglish: Chinese, English, and Japanese are all examples.

words.exampleEnglish: He can speak Mandarin.
words.hintSimplified: 新加坡和台湾常用来称呼中文的词。
words.hintTraditional: 新加坡和台灣常用來稱呼中文的詞。
words.hintEnglish: The term Singapore and Taiwan often use for Chinese.

words.exampleEnglish: I'm learning Chinese.
words.hintSimplified: 常指用汉字写的文字，海外华人学校会教。
words.hintTraditional: 常指用漢字寫的文字，海外華人學校會教。
words.hintEnglish: Often refers to the written language taught in overseas Chinese schools.

words.exampleEnglish: The teacher writes on the blackboard.
words.hintSimplified: 挂在教室前面，用粉笔写字。
words.hintTraditional: 掛在教室前面，用粉筆寫字。
words.hintEnglish: Hung at the front of the classroom, written on with chalk.

words.exampleEnglish: Please open your textbook.
words.hintSimplified: 学生上课用的书。
words.hintTraditional: 學生上課用的書。
words.hintEnglish: The book students use in class.

words.definition: (coll.) dictionary; CL:本[ben3]; Chinese character dictionary (containing entries for single characters, contrasted with a 詞典|词典[ci2 dian3], which has entries for words of one or more characters)
words.exampleSimplified: 我不懂这个字，查字典吧。
words.exampleTraditional: 我不懂這個字，查字典吧。
words.exampleEnglish: I don't understand this word; let's look it up in the dictionary.
words.hintSimplified: 里面按顺序排着字和字的解释。
words.hintTraditional: 裡面按順序排著字和字的解釋。
words.hintEnglish: Holds characters in order along with their explanations.

words.gloss: to take note of; to pay attention to
words.definition: to take note of; to pay attention to
words.exampleEnglish: Please pay attention to safety.
words.hintSimplified: 把心思放在一件事上，不要忘记。
words.hintTraditional: 把心思放在一件事上，不要忘記。
words.hintEnglish: Focus your mind on something and don't forget it.

words.definition: to attend school; to read a book; to study
words.exampleEnglish: He studies every evening.
words.hintSimplified: 看书学东西，或在学校念书。
words.hintTraditional: 看書學東西，或在學校唸書。
words.hintEnglish: Reading and learning from books, or attending school.

words.definition: reply; answer; to reply; to answer
words.exampleEnglish: Please answer my question.
words.hintSimplified: 别人问了，你说出答案。
words.hintTraditional: 別人問了，你說出答案。
words.hintEnglish: Someone has asked, and you give the response.

words.exampleEnglish: This is the first part of the book.
words.hintSimplified: 整体里的一小块，不是全部。
words.hintTraditional: 整體裡的一小塊，不是全部。
words.hintEnglish: A piece of a whole, not all of it.

words.gloss: to think of a way (to do sth)
words.definition: to think of a way (to do sth); way of thinking; opinion; notion
words.exampleEnglish: I have a good idea.
words.hintSimplified: 脑子里想出来的意见。
words.hintTraditional: 腦子裡想出來的意見。
words.hintEnglish: A view you've come up with in your mind.

words.exampleEnglish: I study Chinese every day.
words.hintSimplified: 为了懂得新的东西而读书、练习。
words.hintTraditional: 為了懂得新的東西而讀書、練習。
words.hintEnglish: Reading and practicing in order to understand new things.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4]; drill; exercise; practice; to practice
words.exampleEnglish: I practice writing every day.
words.hintSimplified: 为了做得更好，一次又一次地做。
words.hintTraditional: 為了做得更好，一次又一次地做。
words.hintEnglish: Doing something again and again to get better at it.

words.gloss: to participate; to take part; to join
words.definition: to participate; to take part; to join
words.exampleEnglish: I want to take part in this event.
words.hintSimplified: 加入一个聚会或比赛。
words.hintTraditional: 加入一個聚會或比賽。
words.hintEnglish: Joining a gathering or competition.

words.definition: CL:個|个[ge4],種|种[zhong3]; civilization; cultural; culture
words.exampleEnglish: Taiwan has a rich culture.
words.hintSimplified: 一个地方的人共同的生活方式、节日和传统。
words.hintTraditional: 一個地方的人共同的生活方式、節日和傳統。
words.hintEnglish: The shared lifestyle, holidays, and traditions of the people of a place.

words.gloss: to believe; to think; to consider; to feel
words.definition: to believe; to think; to consider; to feel
words.exampleEnglish: I think this method is pretty good.
words.hintSimplified: 说出自己对事情的看法。
words.hintTraditional: 說出自己對事情的看法。
words.hintEnglish: Stating your own view of a matter.

words.definition: clear; distinct; to be clear about; to understand thoroughly
words.exampleEnglish: I heard what you said very clearly.
words.hintSimplified: 一点都不模糊，很明白。
words.hintTraditional: 一點都不模糊，很明白。
words.hintEnglish: Not at all blurry; perfectly plain.

words.definition: decision (CL:個|个[ge4],項|项[xiang4]); to decide; to determine; to make up one's mind
words.exampleEnglish: I've decided to go tomorrow.
words.hintSimplified: 想了很久以后，选了一个方向。
words.hintTraditional: 想了很久以後，選了一個方向。
words.hintEnglish: After long thought, choosing a direction.

words.exampleEnglish: Do you still remember me?
words.hintSimplified: 没有忘记过去的事情。
words.hintTraditional: 沒有忘記過去的事情。
words.hintEnglish: Not having forgotten things from the past.

words.definition: CL:條|条[tiao2]; way of handling sth; means; measure; (practical) solution to a problem
words.exampleEnglish: I can't think of a way.
words.hintSimplified: 解决问题时用的做法。
words.hintTraditional: 解決問題時用的做法。
words.hintEnglish: The approach you use to solve a problem.

words.exampleEnglish: This is a good way to study Chinese.
words.hintSimplified: 做一件事的步骤或手段。
words.hintTraditional: 做一件事的步驟或手段。
words.hintEnglish: The steps or means for doing something.

words.exampleEnglish: This book is very useful to me.
words.hintSimplified: 能帮上忙，不是白白浪费。
words.hintTraditional: 能幫上忙，不是白白浪費。
words.hintEnglish: Able to help, not a waste.

words.definition: progress; improvement; to improve; to progress
words.exampleEnglish: Your Chinese has improved a lot.
words.hintSimplified: 比以前更好了。
words.hintTraditional: 比以前更好了。
words.hintEnglish: Better than before.

words.exampleEnglish: Excuse me, where is the toilet?
words.hintSimplified: 想上大号或小号的时候去的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 想上大號或小號的時候去的地方。
words.hintEnglish: The place you go when you need to relieve yourself.

words.definition: CL:間|间[jian1]; dorm room; dormitory; hostel; living quarters
words.exampleEnglish: Students live in the school dormitory.
words.hintSimplified: 学校提供给学生睡觉的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 學校提供給學生睡覺的地方。
words.hintEnglish: Where a school provides students a place to sleep.

words.exampleEnglish: This room is very small.
words.hintSimplified: 有墙、有门，可以住人的空间。
words.hintTraditional: 有牆、有門，可以住人的空間。
words.hintEnglish: A space with walls and a door where people can live.

words.definition: CL:幢[zhuang4],座[zuo4]; building (a relatively large, multistory one)
words.exampleEnglish: This building has twenty floors.
words.hintSimplified: 很高很大的建筑，里面有很多办公室。
words.hintTraditional: 很高很大的建築，裡面有很多辦公室。
words.hintEnglish: A tall, large building with many offices inside.

words.gloss: (Internet slang) previous poster in a forum thread
words.definition: (Internet slang) previous poster in a forum thread; upstairs
words.exampleEnglish: He lives upstairs.
words.hintSimplified: 在同一栋房子里，比你高的一层。
words.hintTraditional: 在同一棟房子裡，比你高的一層。
words.hintEnglish: A floor higher than yours in the same building.

words.exampleEnglish: I'm waiting for you downstairs.
words.hintSimplified: 在同一栋房子里，比你低的一层。
words.hintTraditional: 在同一棟房子裡，比你低的一層。
words.hintEnglish: A floor lower than yours in the same building.

words.exampleEnglish: Please take the stairs.
words.hintSimplified: 一阶一阶的，走上走下用的。
words.hintTraditional: 一階一階的，走上走下用的。
words.hintEnglish: Step by step; you use it to go up and down.

words.exampleSimplified: 电梯坏了，我们走楼梯吧。
words.exampleTraditional: 電梯壞了，我們走樓梯吧。
words.exampleEnglish: The elevator is broken; let's take the stairs.
words.hintSimplified: 在大楼里，按一个按钮就可以带你上下。
words.hintTraditional: 在大樓裡，按一個按鈕就可以帶你上下。
words.hintEnglish: In a tall building, pressing a button takes you up or down.

words.exampleEnglish: Mom is cooking in the kitchen.
words.hintSimplified: 家里煮饭的地方。
words.hintTraditional: 家裡煮飯的地方。
words.hintEnglish: The place at home where meals are cooked.

words.definition: CL:間|间[jian1]; living room; sitting room
words.exampleEnglish: The guests are sitting in the living room.
words.hintSimplified: 家里放沙发和电视的大空间。
words.hintTraditional: 家裡放沙發和電視的大空間。
words.hintEnglish: The big space at home with the sofa and TV.

words.exampleEnglish: Please open the window.
words.hintSimplified: 墙上的玻璃，可以看到外面。
words.hintTraditional: 牆上的玻璃，可以看到外面。
words.hintEnglish: Glass in the wall that lets you see outside.

words.exampleEnglish: There's a tree outside the window.
words.hintSimplified: 开了可以通风，关了可以挡雨。
words.hintTraditional: 開了可以通風，關了可以擋雨。
words.hintEnglish: Open it for ventilation; shut it to keep out rain.

words.exampleEnglish: We're going to buy new furniture.
words.hintSimplified: 桌子、椅子、床都属于这一类。
words.hintTraditional: 桌子、椅子、床都屬於這一類。
words.hintEnglish: Tables, chairs, and beds all belong to this group.

words.gloss: (Internet slang) first reply to a forum post
words.definition: (Internet slang) first reply to a forum post; (loanword) sofa (CL:條|条[tiao2],張|张[zhang1])
words.exampleEnglish: He lay on the sofa watching TV.
words.hintSimplified: 又软又大，客厅里让人坐着休息。
words.hintTraditional: 又軟又大，客廳裡讓人坐著休息。
words.hintEnglish: Big and soft, for sitting and relaxing in the living room.

words.definition: box; case; hezi – a savory turnover-like pie in northern Chinese and Mongolian cuisines
words.exampleEnglish: There's a gift in the box.
words.hintSimplified: 方方的，可以装东西，有盖子。
words.hintTraditional: 方方的，可以裝東西，有蓋子。
words.hintEnglish: Square, can hold things, and has a lid.

words.exampleEnglish: It's too hot; please turn on the air conditioning.
words.hintSimplified: 夏天打开，房间里会变凉。
words.hintTraditional: 夏天開啟，房間裡會變涼。
words.hintEnglish: Turn it on in summer and the room gets cool.

words.exampleEnglish: The milk is in the fridge.
words.hintSimplified: 放在厨房，可以让食物保持冷冻。
words.hintTraditional: 放在廚房，可以讓食物保持冷凍。
words.hintEnglish: Kept in the kitchen to keep food cold.

words.exampleEnglish: His room is very clean.
words.hintSimplified: 没有脏东西，看起来很整齐。
words.hintTraditional: 沒有髒東西，看起來很整齊。
words.hintEnglish: No dirt, looking neat and tidy.

words.gloss: rent for a room or house
words.definition: rent for a room or house
words.exampleSimplified: 这个月的房租要三万块。
words.exampleTraditional: 這個月的房租要三萬塊。
words.exampleEnglish: This month's rent is 30,000 dollars.
words.hintSimplified: 住别人的房子，每个月要付的钱。
words.hintTraditional: 住別人的房子，每個月要付的錢。
words.hintEnglish: Money you pay every month for living in someone else's house.

words.exampleEnglish: I want to travel around the world.
words.hintSimplified: 地球上所有的国家加起来。
words.hintTraditional: 地球上所有的國家加起來。
words.hintEnglish: All the countries on Earth together.

words.exampleEnglish: It snowed on the mountain.
words.hintSimplified: 天气很冷，天上掉下白色的东西。
words.hintTraditional: 天氣很冷，天上掉下白色的東西。
words.hintEnglish: When it's very cold, white flakes fall from the sky.

words.definition: sun; sunlight; sunshine; temple (on the side of the human head) (abbr. for 太陽穴|太阳穴[tai4 yang2 xue2])
words.exampleEnglish: The sun rises from the east.
words.hintSimplified: 白天天空中又圆又亮又热的东西。
words.hintTraditional: 白天天空中又圓又亮又熱的東西。
words.hintEnglish: The round, bright, hot thing in the daytime sky.

words.definition: to bathe; to take a shower
words.exampleEnglish: I take a bath every night.
words.hintSimplified: 用水和肥皂把身体洗干净。
words.hintTraditional: 用水和肥皂把身體洗乾淨。
words.hintEnglish: Washing your body clean with water and soap.

words.exampleEnglish: Are you free tomorrow?
words.hintSimplified: 没有事要忙，可以和别人见面。
words.hintTraditional: 沒有事要忙，可以和別人見面。
words.hintEnglish: Having nothing to be busy with and able to meet others.

words.definition: a discovery; to discover; to find; to detect; to notice; to become aware of
words.exampleEnglish: I found that my wallet was missing.
words.hintSimplified: 第一次看到或知道以前不知道的事。
words.hintTraditional: 第一次看到或知道以前不知道的事。
words.hintEnglish: Seeing or learning for the first time something you didn't know before.

words.gloss: to celebrate the Chinese New Year
words.definition: to celebrate the Chinese New Year
words.exampleEnglish: We go back to our hometown for the New Year.
words.hintSimplified: 农历的新年，家人团聚的节日。
words.hintTraditional: 農曆的新年，家人團聚的節日。
words.hintEnglish: The lunar new year holiday when families reunite.

words.exampleEnglish: Happy New Year!
words.hintSimplified: 一月一号，一年开始的时候。
words.hintTraditional: 一月一號，一年開始的時候。
words.hintEnglish: January first, when a year begins.

words.exampleEnglish: I often go swimming in summer.
words.hintSimplified: 在水里用手脚往前移动。
words.hintTraditional: 在水裡用手腳往前移動。
words.hintEnglish: Moving forward in water with your arms and legs.

words.definition: (military) to march at the double; to jog; to run
words.exampleEnglish: I go running in the park in the morning.
words.hintSimplified: 两只脚很快地交替往前，比走路快。
words.hintTraditional: 兩隻腳很快地交替往前，比走路快。
words.hintEnglish: Your feet alternate quickly, faster than walking.

words.definition: a soccer ball; a football; soccer; football
words.exampleEnglish: They are playing soccer.
words.hintSimplified: 十一个人一队，用脚把球踢进球门。
words.hintTraditional: 十一個人一隊，用腳把球踢進球門。
words.hintEnglish: Eleven players per team kick a ball into the goal.

words.exampleEnglish: My younger brother likes playing basketball.
words.hintSimplified: 把球投进高高的篮子里。
words.hintTraditional: 把球投進高高的籃子裡。
words.hintEnglish: Throwing the ball into a high hoop.

words.exampleEnglish: They're playing tennis on the court.
words.hintSimplified: 用球拍打黄绿色的小球，中间有网。
words.hintTraditional: 用球拍打黃綠色的小球，中間有網。
words.hintEnglish: Hitting a small yellow-green ball with a racket over a net.

words.exampleEnglish: Taiwanese people love watching baseball.
words.hintSimplified: 用长长的球棒打球，然后跑四个垒。
words.hintTraditional: 用長長的球棒打球，然後跑四個壘。
words.hintEnglish: Hitting a ball with a long bat and running around four bases.

words.definition: CL:場|场[chang3],次[ci4]; competition (sports etc); match; to compete
words.exampleEnglish: There's a soccer match tomorrow.
words.hintSimplified: 两队或几个人互相比较，看谁赢。
words.hintTraditional: 兩隊或幾個人互相比較，看誰贏。
words.hintEnglish: Teams or people compete against each other to see who wins.

words.definition: beginning; start; to begin; to start
words.exampleEnglish: The movie starts at eight.
words.hintSimplified: 一件事情的第一刻。
words.hintTraditional: 一件事情的第一刻。
words.hintEnglish: The first moment of something.

words.gloss: (of a document etc) to be uploaded to the Internet
words.definition: (of a document etc) to be uploaded to the Internet; (tennis, volleyball etc) to move in close to the net; to connect to the Internet; to go online
words.exampleSimplified: 我晚上喜欢上网看新闻。
words.exampleTraditional: 我晚上喜歡上網看新聞。
words.exampleEnglish: I like going online in the evening to read the news.
words.hintSimplified: 用手机或电脑连到网络。
words.hintTraditional: 用手機或電腦連到網路。
words.hintEnglish: Connecting to the web with a phone or computer.

words.exampleEnglish: The Internet at home is slow.
words.hintSimplified: 把全世界的电脑连在一起的系统。
words.hintTraditional: 把全世界的電腦連在一起的系統。
words.hintEnglish: A system that links computers all over the world.

words.exampleEnglish: This website has lots of news.
words.hintSimplified: 在网络上，有一页一页的内容让人看。
words.hintTraditional: 在網路上，有一頁一頁的內容讓人看。
words.hintEnglish: Found online, with pages of content for people to view.

words.exampleEnglish: Dad reads the newspaper every morning.
words.hintSimplified: 每天印出来，有新闻的大张纸。
words.hintTraditional: 每天印出來，有新聞的大張紙。
words.hintEnglish: Printed every day on big sheets with the news.

words.exampleEnglish: I like listening to music.
words.hintSimplified: 歌曲和乐器发出来的好听声音。
words.hintTraditional: 歌曲和樂器發出來的好聽聲音。
words.hintEnglish: The pleasant sounds from songs and instruments.

words.gloss: (outdoor etc) activity; event; (political) campaign; (military) maneuver (CL:項|项[xiang4])
words.definition: (outdoor etc) activity; event; (political) campaign; (military) maneuver (CL:項|项[xiang4]); (volcanic, seismic, economic etc) activity; movable; flexible; liquid (capital etc); shaky; unsteady; loose (tooth etc); to exercise; to move about; to work out; to use personal influence, connections, bribes etc
words.exampleEnglish: There's an event at school tomorrow.
words.hintSimplified: 大家一起来玩的聚会或比赛。
words.hintTraditional: 大家一起來玩的聚會或比賽。
words.hintEnglish: A gathering or contest where everyone comes to have fun.

words.exampleSimplified: 奶奶给我讲了一个故事。
words.exampleTraditional: 奶奶給我講了一個故事。
words.exampleEnglish: Grandma told me a story.
words.hintSimplified: 睡前爸妈常讲给小孩听的内容。
words.hintTraditional: 睡前爸媽常講給小孩聽的內容。
words.hintEnglish: What parents often tell their children before bed.

words.exampleEnglish: We chat at the coffee shop.
words.hintSimplified: 轻松地和朋友说各种话题。
