words.exampleEnglish: She eats an apple every day.
words.hintSimplified: 圆圆的红色或绿色水果，也是一家手机公司的名字。
words.hintTraditional: 圓圓的紅色或綠色水果，也是一家手機公司的名字。
words.hintEnglish: A round red or green fruit, also the name of a phone company.

words.exampleEnglish: Eating watermelon in summer is refreshing.
words.hintSimplified: 外面绿色，里面红红的大水果。
words.hintTraditional: 外面綠色，裡面紅紅的大水果。
words.hintEnglish: A big fruit that's green outside and red inside.

words.exampleEnglish: He drank a glass of beer.
words.hintSimplified: 金黄色，有泡泡，成年人喝的酒。
words.hintTraditional: 金黃色，有泡泡，成年人喝的酒。
words.hintEnglish: A golden, foamy alcoholic drink for adults.

words.exampleEnglish: I drink black tea in the morning.
words.hintSimplified: 茶叶发酵过，泡出来的茶是红褐色。
words.hintTraditional: 茶葉發酵過，泡出來的茶是紅褐色。
words.hintEnglish: Fermented tea leaves brew into a reddish-brown drink.

words.definition: dessert; dim sum (in Cantonese cooking); light refreshments; pastry
words.exampleEnglish: In the afternoon we have snacks.
words.hintSimplified: 正餐之外，吃的小甜食。
words.hintTraditional: 正餐之外，吃的小甜食。
words.hintEnglish: Little sweets eaten outside main meals.

words.exampleEnglish: Eating vegetables is good for the body.
words.hintSimplified: 绿色叶子的蔬菜。
words.hintTraditional: 綠色葉子的蔬菜。
words.hintEnglish: Vegetables with green leaves.

words.exampleEnglish: Please give me a fork.
words.hintSimplified: 西餐里用来叉食物。
words.hintTraditional: 西餐裡用來叉食物。
words.hintEnglish: Used in Western meals to spear food.

words.exampleEnglish: This knife is very sharp.
words.hintSimplified: 切东西用，要小心拿。
words.hintTraditional: 切東西用，要小心拿。
words.hintEnglish: Used to cut things and must be handled carefully.

words.exampleEnglish: Please use a spoon to drink the soup.
words.hintSimplified: 喝汤时拿的小工具。
words.hintTraditional: 喝湯時拿的小工具。
words.hintEnglish: The small tool you hold when eating soup.

words.exampleEnglish: There are three dumplings on the plate.
words.hintSimplified: 圆圆扁扁的，用来装菜。
words.hintTraditional: 圓圓扁扁的，用來裝菜。
words.hintEnglish: Round and flat, used to serve food.

words.exampleEnglish: There's water in the bottle.
words.hintSimplified: 口小肚子大，可以装水或饮料。
words.hintTraditional: 口小肚子大，可以裝水或飲料。
words.hintEnglish: A narrow mouth and a big belly; it holds water or drinks.

words.exampleEnglish: I got full after eating half.
words.hintSimplified: 把东西平分成两份的其中一份。
words.hintTraditional: 把東西平分成兩份的其中一份。
words.hintEnglish: One of the two equal parts of something.

words.definition: (dialect) smell; odor; (fig.) feeling (of ...); sense (of ...); hint (of ...); (fig.) interest; delight; flavor; taste
words.exampleEnglish: The flavor of this dish is very good.
words.hintSimplified: 舌头或鼻子感觉到的东西。
words.hintTraditional: 舌頭或鼻子感覺到的東西。
words.hintEnglish: What the tongue or nose senses.

words.exampleEnglish: I finished eating all of it.
words.hintSimplified: 没有一个漏掉，整个的。
words.hintTraditional: 沒有一個漏掉，整個的。
words.hintEnglish: Without missing a single bit; the whole thing.

words.definition: all; to have; to possess; to own
words.exampleEnglish: All the students have come.
words.hintSimplified: 没有例外，每一个。
words.hintTraditional: 沒有例外，每一個。
words.hintEnglish: Without exception, every single one.

words.definition: needs; to need; to want; to demand; to require
words.exampleEnglish: I need your help.
words.hintSimplified: 缺少某样东西，必须得到。
words.hintTraditional: 缺少某樣東西，必須得到。
words.hintEnglish: Lacking something and having to get it.

words.exampleEnglish: I want to go, but I'm too tired.
words.hintSimplified: 前后意思不同时用的连接词。
words.hintTraditional: 前後意思不同時用的連線詞。
words.hintEnglish: A connector used when the two parts differ in meaning.

words.definition: either one or the other; or
words.exampleEnglish: Would you like tea or coffee?
words.hintSimplified: 连接两个可以选的东西。
words.hintTraditional: 連線兩個可以選的東西。
words.hintEnglish: Links two things you could choose from.

words.exampleEnglish: If you're free, come and see me.
words.hintSimplified: 说“假如”的另一种口语说法。
words.hintTraditional: 說“假如”的另一種口語說法。
words.hintEnglish: Another casual way to say "suppose."

words.gloss: although; even though (often used correlatively with 可是[ke3 shi4] or 但是[dan4 shi4] etc)
words.definition: although; even though (often used correlatively with 可是[ke3 shi4] or 但是[dan4 shi4] etc)
words.exampleSimplified: 虽然很累，但是他还是去了。
words.exampleTraditional: 雖然很累，但是他還是去了。
words.exampleEnglish: Although he was tired, he still went.
words.hintSimplified: 先承认一个事实，后面意思会转折。
words.hintTraditional: 先承認一個事實，後面意思會轉折。
words.hintEnglish: First admits a fact, and then the meaning turns around.

words.definition: (before a number) ... or so; about ...; like that; in that way; to that extent; then; in that case; variant of 那麼|那么[na4 me5]
words.exampleEnglish: Why are you so happy?
words.hintSimplified: 表示程度很高，指着前面说过的。
words.hintTraditional: 表示程度很高，指著前面說過的。
words.hintEnglish: Shows a high degree, pointing back at what's been said.

words.definition: how much?; like this; so much; this much; this way; variant of 這麼|这么[zhe4 me5]
words.exampleEnglish: Why is it so cold today?
words.hintSimplified: 表示程度，指着眼前的情况。
words.hintTraditional: 表示程度，指著眼前的情況。
words.hintEnglish: Shows degree, pointing at what's right in front of you.

words.definition: at first; it goes without saying; of course; original; originally
words.exampleSimplified: 我本来想去，可是下雨了。
words.exampleTraditional: 我本來想去，可是下雨了。
words.exampleEnglish: I originally wanted to go, but it rained.
words.hintSimplified: 一开始是这样，后来变了。
words.hintTraditional: 一開始是這樣，後來變了。
words.hintEnglish: That's how it was at the start, but later it changed.

words.gloss: to think; to believe (often with the implication that the belief is mistaken – unless referring to one's own current belief)
words.definition: to think; to believe (often with the implication that the belief is mistaken – unless referring to one's own current belief)
words.exampleEnglish: I thought you weren't coming.
words.hintSimplified: 心里想的事，结果不是真的。
words.hintTraditional: 心裡想的事，結果不是真的。
words.hintEnglish: What you thought turned out not to be true.

words.exampleEnglish: Some people like eating sweet things.
words.hintSimplified: 说一部分人或东西，不是全部。
words.hintTraditional: 說一部分人或東西，不是全部。
words.hintEnglish: Talking about a portion of people or things, not all.

words.gloss: (after a verb) a bit; a little (indicating brief duration, or softening the tone, or suggesting giving sth a try)
words.definition: (after a verb) a bit; a little (indicating brief duration, or softening the tone, or suggesting giving sth a try); all at once; suddenly
words.exampleEnglish: Please wait a moment.
words.hintSimplified: 放在动词后面，让动作变短、变轻松。
words.hintTraditional: 放在動詞後面，讓動作變短、變輕鬆。
words.hintEnglish: Placed after a verb to make the action brief and casual.

words.gloss: anyway (to get back to a previous topic)
words.definition: anyway (to get back to a previous topic); but; cannot be more (after adjectival); however; merely; no more than; only
words.exampleEnglish: This is good, but a bit expensive.
words.hintSimplified: 轻轻转折，说一个小问题。
words.hintTraditional: 輕輕轉折，說一個小問題。
words.hintEnglish: A gentle turn to mention a small problem.
